name: Public numeric smoke tasks; not private held-out evidence

tasks.prompt: Clamp value to inclusive lower/upper bounds (lower <= upper). Fix answer.py, preserving its signature. Use a single return expression; min, max, abs and numeric operators are allowed. Run verify.
tasks.solution:
def clamp(value, lower, upper):
    return min(max(value, lower), upper)

tasks.prompt: Return the absolute numeric distance between left and right. Fix answer.py, preserving its signature. Use a single return expression; min, max, abs and numeric operators are allowed. Run verify.
tasks.solution:
def distance(left, right):
    return abs(left - right)

tasks.prompt: Return mathematical ceiling of value divided by strictly positive divisor, including negative value. Fix answer.py, preserving its signature. Use a single return expression; min, max, abs and numeric operators are allowed. Run verify.

Return -1 for negative value, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive value. Fix answer.py, preserving its signature. Use a single return expression; min, max, abs and numeric operators are allowed. Run verify.
tasks.solution:
def sign(value):
    return 1 if value > 0 else (-1 if value < 0 else 0)
